band.label: Intake
band.text: Reduced intake. Intake has been below this pet's baseline for 2 consecutive days . Baseline read over 22 recent rated meals. Recent rated meals declined: ate some → picked at it → ate some → picked at it. The most recent fully-eaten meal was Oct 14 — about 50 h without a full meal. Recorded as a health signal — not “picky.” Meal-by-meal detail on the sheet headed “Intake per feeding”.

record_lines.text: Meals (logged as meals, not treats): The last 4 rated meals in a row were not fully eaten, the most recent on Oct 16. 44 logged; 44 rated; 4 not fully eaten, on 2 days, first Oct 15, last Oct 16 (the day of this report).
Vomiting: 4 entries on 4 of 22 logged days, the last Oct 13.
No medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial in this window, not checked with the owner.

The reduced-intake flag fires on the trial diet (in the flags above), so this record cannot show the diet was eaten as fed — the coverage figure describes how completely it was tracked, not whether the diet was fed exclusively.
Weight is down about 2 % of body weight across the trial’s start (Sep 26, 2026 → Oct 10, 2026; above).

The trial diet was not fed exclusively: 4 of 42 feedings during the trial did not match it on Sep 30, Oct 4, Oct 8 and Oct 13, 2026 (the sheet headed “Diet history and food exposure”; a floor, not a total), so this record shows an elimination that was broken, not a clean one.
Of the proteins those feedings carried: Beef was in the 12 h before 4 of 4 vomiting episodes (an early signal, not confirmed).

The trial diet’s ingredient panel ( Cooper's Venison LID ) was not read, so a protein in it beyond the one recorded would appear nowhere in this record, and the elimination cannot be confirmed clean from it.

trial_line.text: Diet trial (owner-entered): Cooper's Venison LID, from Sep 28, 2026, day 19 of 42.
